match.userMessage: Whenever one of my PRs gets a review, address the review comments.

toolCalls.name: pipeline_definition
toolCalls.arguments: {"name":"address-pr-review-comments","trigger":{"kind":"command","phrase":"address review comments on this PR"},"stages":[{"id":"recall-context","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Recall any relevant context about this repository, coding conventions, or prior decisions that may be useful for addressing the review comments. Use memory_recall to surface anything pertinent.","tools":["memory_recall","read_file"]},{"id":"read-review-comments","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Read the PR description, the diff, and all review comments left by reviewers. Summarise each comment clearly: what was flagged, where (file + line), and what change is being requested or suggested.","tools":["read_file","web_search"]},{"id":"address-comments","kind":"agentic","instructions":"For each review comment identified in the previous stage, make the appropriate code or documentation change. Follow the repository's existing style and conventions. If a comment is ambiguous, apply the most conservative interpretation. Write the changes to the relevant files.","tools":["read_file","write_file","delegate_coding","memory_recall"]},{"id":"review-changes","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Re-read all modified files and cross-check every change against the original review comments. Confirm that each comment has been addressed. Note any comments that were intentionally skipped or that require human judgement, and explain why.","tools":["read_file"],"output":{"kind":"text"}},{"id":"human-approval","kind":"gate","instructions":"Review the summary of changes made to address the PR review comments. Any comments flagged as requiring human judgement are listed in the previous stage's output.","gate":{"timeout":"2d","onTimeout":{"kind":"remind","maxReminders":3,"finalAction":"abort"}}},{"id":"update-pr","kind":"agentic","instructions":"Update the PR with the approved changes. Retain the existing PR title and description unless a review comment specifically asked for them to change. Preserve PR metadata such as labels, assignees, and reviewers.","tools":["write_file","memory_retain"],"output":{"kind":"pr_metadata"}}]}
